mapper.select: select a.contractId,a.contractName,a.ruleserialNum,b.CreatedBy as createUserId,b.CreatedDate as createDate, b.OffereePerformRemark as offereePerformRemark from cr_contractbasic a inner join cr_contractend b on a.contractId=b.contractId inner join cr_contractofferee c on a.contractId=c.contractId inner join ff_offereeinfo d on c.offereeId=d.offereeId ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.contractId,a.contractName,a.ruleserialNum from cr_contractbasic a inner join cr_contractcase b on a.contractId=b.contractId inner join cr_contractofferee c on a.contractId=c.contractId inner join ff_offereeinfo d on c.offereeId=d.offereeId ${ew.customSqlSegment}
